sourceOfTruth: This HI-TECH repository and main branch are the only active development source of truth.

taskPolicy.newTaskBranchPolicy: A new task branch is permitted only for a genuinely new evidence-backed gap, must start from current main, and must merge back through QA.

prohibitedActions: new development in OLD or LEGACY repositories
fixes or redesigns in OLD or LEGACY repositories
deployment or content updates in OLD or LEGACY repositories
recreating already completed work without failure evidence
creating duplicate repositories, previews, dashboards, folders or websites for completed scope
promoting an OLD or LEGACY branch to active source without explicit reconciliation into this master
normal development writes directly to protected main
force-pushing or destructively moving protected refs
weakening required CI or repository protection to obtain a green result
merging before exact-head required checks pass
automated or API merge without an expected-head SHA guard
